turns.text: ok im so tired lol. bought a used e-bike today for $640 so my savings are basically gone, rebuilding to $1500 now for spring textbooks and transfer fees 🫠 gonna charge it behind the cafe counter. anyway can u help me with cranial nerves, the practical is next friday and i need to nail the nerves

Congrats on the e-bike! Happy to help with the nerves. Here's a quick map of all 12:

- I Olfactory: smell
- II Optic: vision
- III Oculomotor: most eye movement, pupil constriction, eyelid
- IV Trochlear: superior oblique
- V Trigeminal: face sensation, chewing
- VI Abducens: lateral rectus
- VII Facial: expression, taste (front 2/3 of tongue)
- VIII Vestibulocochlear: hearing, balance
- IX Glossopharyngeal: throat, taste (back of tongue)
- X Vagus: heart, lungs, gut
- XI Accessory: trapezius, SCM
- XII Hypoglossal: tongue movement

Want a memory trick, or a quiz?
can u tag the nerves green to match my notes pls. too long otherwise lol. and then quiz me on the yellow list, i trimmed it to 40 structures
